ABC News live updates, 18 July 2026. Timestamps as published in EDT (EDT + 5 hours = BST).

10:20 AM EDT (3:20 PM BST) - Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi: Iran is not implementing its commitments and is "busy defending the country."

Iran's Ambassador to Pakistan Reza Amiri Moghadam (social media): the US interpreted the Memorandum of Understanding "contrary to its terms and gained control over parts of Strait Hormuz." He also said: "Now, the US has started a war contrary to the terms of MOU and international principles destroying the infrastructures."

7:30 PM EDT (00:30 BST 19 July) - CENTCOM statement: US forces completed a seventh consecutive night of strikes, hitting "surveillance sites, military logistics infrastructure, underground weapons storage and maritime capabilities."

8:48 AM EDT (1:48 PM BST) - Iran Health Ministry: US airstrikes have killed at least 50 people and wounded more than 500 since July 6.

Strait of Hormuz described as "the primary flashpoint", with CENTCOM enforcing "a naval blockade against Iranian ports."

No IAEA or oil-price detail in this article.
